meta.title: The Leather Store — Handpicked Leather Shoes, Bags, Watches & More
meta.description: The Leather Store is a family-run boutique for handpicked leather shoes, sandals, sneakers, sunglasses, wrist watches, ladies handbags, gents wallets, travel bags and perfumes. Visit us in store.

slides.title: Leather that {remembers} you
slides.text: Hand-selected hides, hand-finished edges, and a fit our team checks in person. Rare, handpicked pieces you will not find down the street.

slides.title: Time, {properly} kept
slides.text: Swiss-grade automatics and slim quartz dress watches — each one regulated and strap-sized before you walk out.

slides.title: Carry it with {intent}
slides.text: Saffiano totes, quilted lambskin crossbodies and suede buckets — structured to hold their shape for years.

slides.title: Streets, {softened}
slides.text: Polarised and gradient frames with the right amount of edge — made to wear from first light to late afternoon.

slides.title: A scent worth {remembering}
slides.text: Oud, amber and citrus compositions at 18–24% concentration. Sample every bottle on skin, in store.

values.title: Genuine leather, always
values.text: Every hide is sourced from certified tanneries and checked by hand before it enters the shop.

values.title: Fitted in person
values.text: Shoes sized on both feet, watch straps adjusted, frames bent to your face — free, for life.

categoriesSection.title: Everything under one roof
categoriesSection.text: Footwear, eyewear, timepieces, bags and fragrance — curated by hand, stocked on the shelf, and ready to try on today.

catalog.title: Every item in the store
catalog.text: Browse the whole shop below, or jump to a collection. Tap any product for photos, a video and full specifications.

story.title: A shop built on {touch}, not on trends
story.imageAlt: Hand-finished leather goods on the workbench
paragraphs: We started in {ESTABLISHED} with one counter and one rule: nothing leaves the shop that we would not carry ourselves.

Today {STORE} spans nine categories — footwear, eyewear, timepieces, bags, wallets and fragrance — but the rule has not changed. Every article is picked by hand, checked before it reaches the shelf, and sold to you by the same person who chose it.

items.text: I have bought three pairs of shoes here over six years. The first pair has been resoled twice and still looks better than anything new I own.
items.name: Anand Krishnan

items.text: They spent forty minutes helping me choose a handbag and did not once try to upsell me. That is why I keep coming back with my friends.
items.name: Priya Menon

items.text: Bought a watch as a gift. They sized the bracelet, set the time, boxed it and refused to charge for any of it. Rare service.
items.name: Vikram Shetty

visitCta.title: Everything on this page is on the shelf, today
